reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Repeated streamed calls to the same tool share a mutable FunctionInfo instance, causing later arguments and IDs to overwrite earlier calls and resulting in incorrect executions and duplicate tool-call IDs.
1 open issue - [Clone tool definitions for repeated calls to the same tool](https://github.com/LLPhant/LLPhant/pull/535#discussion_r4578983006) · New
What changed in this PR This PR adds streamed tool-call handling to LLPhant’s `LmStudioChat`, following the approach introduced for `OpenAIChat` in #532. **Changes:** - Collects tool-call argument fragments and executes completed calls, including turns ending with `stop`. - Shares tool execution and message construction between streamed and non-streamed paths, then continues with a non-streamed answer. - Adds unit tests for text streaming, fragmented arguments, and calls without indexes. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​Unit/​Chat/​LmStudioChatTest.php | Adds mocked stream tests for text and tool-call responses. | | src/​Chat/​LmStudioChat.php | Handles streamed tool calls and extracts shared tool-execution logic. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: `getFunctionInfoFromName()` returns the registered object, so two streamed calls to the same tool put the same `FunctionInfo` instance into `$functionsToCall` twice. The second call overwrites the first call's arguments and ID before either executes: requests for weather in Paris and Venice both execute with Venice and produce duplicate tool-call IDs in the follow-up messages. Clone the definition for each collected call before setting its arguments and ID, and add a regression case with two calls to the same tool.
